verdict.rationale: Asana's app directory lists sync integrations, including the Asana-branded Jira Cloud Data Sync and a connector covering Jira, Azure DevOps, monday.com and Wrike, that pull work from other PM tools into Asana. This could bring tasks into one place, but nothing documents a unified 'my assigned tasks' view across tools, and several connectors appear to be marketplace apps rather than core features. Missing for 10: a documented unified view of assigned tasks across tools, evidence that synced assignees appear in a personal task list, clarity on first-party versus third-party connectors, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: Connect Asana with Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Zendesk, GitHub, GitLab, monday.com, Wrike, or another Asana project. Keep teams aligned with automated one-way or two-way data synchronization — without manual updates or switching tools.
Connect workflows seamlessly, boost visibility, and optimize productivity between technical and non-technical teams with the Asana for Jira Cloud Data Sync integration.
